fusions.name: Portcullis
fusions.desc: Drops bars around you that deal 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: No Way Out
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A blow that deals 18 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Inescapable] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spring Cell
fusions.desc: Sets a spring-loaded cell at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, then slams shut on the first enemy to come within 2 tiles: it deals 22 damage and leaves that enemy [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bars of Your Own
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
